mapper.sql: ID, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_ID, SOURCE_VERSION, REVIEW_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_BY, REQUEST_ID, TRACE_ID, CREATED_AT, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, VERSION_NO
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ( SELECT FROM AUDIT_TASK WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType} AND SOURCE_ID = #{sourceId} AND REVIEW_TYPE = #{reviewType} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY SOURCE_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID DESC ) AS SOURCE_ROW_NO FROM AUDIT_TASK WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType} AND REVIEW_TYPE = #{reviewType} ) LATEST_BY_SOURCE WHERE SOURCE_ROW_NO = 1 ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AUDIT_TASK WHERE SOURCE_TYPE = #{sourceType} AND REVIEW_TYPE = #{reviewType}
mapper.update: UPDATE AUDIT_TASK SET STATUS = #{targetStatus}, STARTED_AT = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} = 'PROCESSING' THEN #{occurredAt} ELSE STARTED_AT END, FINISHED_AT = CASE WHEN #{targetStatus} IN ('DONE', 'FAILED') THEN #{occurredAt} ELSE FINISHED_AT END, VERSION_NO = VERSION_NO + 1 WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = #{expectedStatus} AND VERSION_NO = #{expectedVersion}
